messages:
deploy-bot: Kicking off staged rollout v3.4.2 -> canary 7% in ap-south during change window 09:00-11:00 UTC. Release notes: https://redwood.example/releases/3.4.2 :rocket:
sam: noticing encoder p95 +180ms on a subset of nodes immediately after shift. no 5xx spike yet.
ivy: can we hold at 7% while infra digs in? request: STOP advance. :hand:
leo: agreed hold. set rollback trigger: sustained p95 >600ms for 5m OR error-rate >0.7%. rollback cmd `/deploy rollback --to v3.4.0 --scope canary`. pin canary to v3.4.2.
ops-amber: pulling logs; seeing kvcache churn on enc-2 and enc-3. snippet:
```
Apr 02 09:12 enc-2 INFO kvcache evict keys=980 size=1.5G
Apr 02 09:13 enc-3 WARN slowpath token_latency=710ms req_id=def456
```
ops-amber: starting heap profile and increasing kvcache TTL on canary hosts as an emergency mitigation. will report ETA ~6m. :wrench:
deploy-bot: Traffic advance paused per request. Canary pinned at 7%. Notifying oncall.
sam: thanks. if TTL tweak reduces p95 below baseline within two consecutive 5m windows, we'll propose a lift-vote. otherwise prep rollback. @natalie-oncall can you watch traces and confirm tail behavior? :eyes:
natalie-oncall: ack. watching dashboards and sampling traces. will post telemetry every 3m. :white_check_mark:
